# Upstream maintenance fixture

Both folders are synthetic, isolated SMAPI flat source packages. The oracle was
written from the visible keys and values before the comparison implementation.
It distinguishes native-key continuity, changed text, a unique rename candidate,
ambiguous split/merge shapes, key reuse, and equal text under distinct keys.
The same test flow also uses the licensed 532-key Lookup Anything fixture as a
real first-domain shape; these synthetic files do not claim game compatibility.
